# Calculator.Net

> > Comprehensive online calculator suite covering mathematics, finance, health, science, and everyday computations

Calculator.Net provides hundreds of specialized calculators spanning mathematical operations (prime factorization, exponents, LCM), financial planning (mortgages, refinancing, college costs, payback periods), health and fitness (body type), physics (Ohm's Law), and practical utilities (age, date, percentage calculations). The site also offers WordPress plugins for embedding popular calculators.

## Key Topics

- Financial Planning & Mortgages
- Mathematical Calculations
- Prime Factorization & Number Theory
- Percentage & Statistical Analysis
- Date & Time Calculations
- Ohm's Law & Electrical Calculations
- WordPress Plugins & Widgets
- Body Type & Health Metrics
- Real Estate & Loan Analysis
- Standard Deviation & Variance
- HTML & JavaScript Integration
- College Cost Estimation
- Age & Date Arithmetic
- Triangle Geometry
- Heat Index & Weather

## Mathematical & Statistical Calculators

- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/percent-calculator.html): Computes percentage values, differences, and changes between numbers
- [Standard Deviation Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/standard-deviation-calculator.html): Computes standard deviation, variance, mean, sum, and error margin
- [Exponent Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/exponent-calculator.html): Computes exponentiation results including expressions with base e
- [Prime Factorization Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/prime-factorization-calculator.html): Finds prime factors and factor tree using fundamental theorem
- [Least Common Multiple Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/lcm-calculator.html): Determines LCM using prime factorization, brute force, or GCF method
- [Factor Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/factor-calculator.html): Computes integer factors and prime factorization of given numbers
- [Percent Error Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/percent-error-calculator.html): Calculates percentage error between observed and true measurements
- [Triangle Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/triangle-calculator.html): Computes triangle edges, angles, area, height, perimeter, median

## Financial & Real Estate Calculators

- [Real Estate Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/real-estate-calculator.html): Collection of mortgage, FHA/VA loan, rental, and property calculators
- [Refinance Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/refinance-calculator.html): Compares existing vs refinanced loans with cash out & fee options
- [Payback Period Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/payback-period-calculator.html): Calculates payback period and ROI from steady or irregular cash flows
- [College Cost Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/college-cost-calculator.html): Estimates U.S. college costs using average data or custom inputs

## Date & Time Calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/age-calculator.html): Computes age in years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds
- [Date Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/date-calculator.html): Calculates date differences and adds/subtracts days with holidays

## Science & Engineering Calculators

- [Ohms Law Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/ohms-law-calculator.html): Solves Ohm's Law variables for voltage, current, resistance & power
- [Heat Index Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/heat-index-calculator.html): Estimates perceived temperature using NWS heat index from humidity

## Health & Lifestyle Calculators

- [Body Type Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/body-type-calculator.html): Estimates body type from bust/waist/hip measurements for clothing fit
- [Golf Handicap Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/golf-handicap-calculator.html): Calculates course handicap and WHS handicap index from past scores

## WordPress Plugins & Widgets

- [Mortgage Loan Calculator Plugin for WordPress](https://www.calculator.net/projects/mortgage-calculator-widget.php): WordPress plugin for Mortgage Calculator with HTML/JavaScript setup
- [Love Calculator Plugin for WordPress](https://www.calculator.net/projects/love-calculator-widget.php): WordPress plugin for Love Calculator widget with installation guide
